meta.title: LloydPans Media Attribution Dashboard
meta.scope_note: Frozen read-only GA4 source / medium comparison snapshot. Average active time is GA4 user-engagement duration divided by sessions. GA4 outbound clicks are enhanced-measurement outbound-link click events; they are not ad-platform delivery clicks. Purchase revenue is GA4 attribution evidence, not Magento source-of-truth revenue or campaign ROI.
meta.pizza_grain_note: Pizza Today source-grain comparison rows sum to 8,254 sessions. Its separate direct all-period GA4 cohort is 8,335 sessions. Checkout, purchase, and GA4 revenue metrics reconcile exactly; the 81-session gap is a GA4 dimension-grain variance and is shown explicitly.

cohorts.label: Pizza Today
cohorts.definition: Every GA4 session source / medium containing Pizza Today or pizzatoday. This includes tagged placements and pizzatoday.com referral traffic.

cohorts.label: Organic Search
cohorts.definition: All raw GA4 source / medium rows whose medium is organic. This matches LloydPans monthly-reporting treatment, not GA4's broader default channel group.

cohorts.label: Google Paid
cohorts.definition: Google / CPC plus the documented legacy googleads forms with missing or referral medium. Those legacy forms are treated as Paid Search, not publisher traffic.

cohorts.label: Other Paid Social
cohorts.definition: Explicit paid social source / medium rows for Meta, Reddit, Pinterest, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and similar platforms, after excluding Pizza Today and known paid-publisher mappings.

cohorts.label: Paid Publishers
cohorts.definition: Known named paid-publisher sources such as FoodService, PMQ / Pizza Pulse, and Facebook Featured Offerings, excluding Pizza Today because it remains its own cohort.
